# Signaturizer — Product Definition (Finalized)

## Vision
A lightweight Electron + Svelte desktop app for Linux inspired by macOS Preview's signature workflow. Captures handwritten signatures via webcam, processes them into transparent images, and stamps them onto PDF documents — with added color control that Preview lacks.

## UX Model (Inspired by macOS Preview)
The app follows Preview's integrated approach: **the PDF is always the primary view**. Signature capture and management are contextual overlays, not separate screens.

### Main Workflow
1. User opens a PDF → sees the document full view
2. Toolbar at top with signature tools
3. Click "Sign" button → dropdown shows saved signatures + "Create New" option
4. "Create New" → opens camera capture modal (not a separate screen)
5. Camera modal: live feed + alignment guide + capture button + threshold slider
6. After capture → rectangular crop adjustment → process (bg removal) → preview → Save to library
7. Click a saved signature → it appears on the PDF → drag to move, handles to resize
8. Choose color tint for the placed signature
9. File → Export signed PDF

## Target Platform
- **v1:** Linux (x64)
- **Future:** macOS and Windows (architect for cross-platform from day one)

## Tech Stack
| Layer | Choice | Rationale |
|-------|--------|-----------|
| Runtime | Electron | Desktop capabilities, file system, webcam |
| UI Framework | Svelte | Lightweight, great DX, compiles to vanilla JS |
| Bundler/Tooling | electron-forge + Svelte plugin | Official Electron tooling |
| PDF Manipulation | pdf-lib | Pure JS, zero native deps, embeds images |
| PDF Rendering | pdf.js (Mozilla) | Render PDF pages in canvas for preview |
| Image Processing | HTML5 Canvas API | In renderer, no native deps |
| Persistence | JSON files in Electron userData | Simple, no native deps |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS | Clean, modern, utility-first |
| Offline | Fully offline | No network calls |

## Feature Details

### 1. Webcam Signature Capture (Modal Popup)
- Opens as a modal overlay on the PDF view (like Preview)
- Live camera feed with alignment guide (horizontal line like Preview's blue line)
- Manual capture via button click (v1)
- Highest available camera resolution
- After capture: user adjusts rectangular crop area
- Threshold slider for background removal, with real-time preview
- "Done" saves to library, "Clear" retries
- Camera dropdown to select from multiple cameras if available

### 2. Image Processing
- Grayscale + configurable white-threshold → transparent PNG
- Real-time preview of processed result in the modal
- Output: transparent PNG stored as base64 in signature library
- Processing happens on Canvas in renderer process

### 3. Signature Library (Preview-Style Dropdown)
- Click "Sign" button → dropdown/popup shows list of saved signatures with thumbnails
- Hover → X button to delete
- "Create New" option at top of dropdown
- Each entry: { id, name (optional label), imageData (base64 PNG), createdAt }
- Stored in JSON in userData directory, persists across sessions
- Multiple signatures supported

### 4. PDF Viewer (Primary View)
- PDF rendered via pdf.js onto canvas — this is ALWAYS the main view
- Page navigation (prev/next, page number, scroll)
- Zoom controls
- Clean toolbar at top: File operations, Sign button, page controls

### 5. Signature Placement (Like Preview)
- Click signature from dropdown → appears on current PDF page
- Drag to reposition anywhere
- Corner handles to resize (maintain aspect ratio)
- Multiple signature instances per document allowed
- Signatures on different pages
- Each placed signature is independently selectable/movable

### 6. Color Tinting (Our Differentiator)
- Select a placed signature → color options appear (sidebar or floating panel)
- Preset colors: black, blue, dark gray
- Custom color picker
- Implemented via Canvas globalCompositeOperation on the signature image
- Color applied before embedding into PDF

### 7. PDF Export
- "File → Export Signed PDF" or Export button
- Uses pdf-lib to embed transparent PNG(s) at correct coordinates/scale
- Save as new file (never overwrite original)
- Native file dialog for save location

### 8. UI/UX Direction
- Clean, modern, minimal — inspired by Preview's simplicity
- Tailwind CSS, light theme
- PDF always primary view
- Overlays/modals for capture and management
- Toolbar-based interaction

## Architecture
```
Main Process: window management, file dialogs, IPC bridge
Renderer Process: all UI (Svelte), camera, image processing (Canvas), PDF rendering
IPC: file system operations only (open/save dialogs, userData read/write)
No native Node modules — pure JS everywhere for cross-platform future
```

## v1 Scope (IN)
- Webcam capture with alignment guide + rectangular crop
- Background removal with threshold control + live preview
- Signature library with persistence (dropdown style)
- PDF viewing, signature placement (drag/resize), color tinting
- PDF export with embedded signatures
- Linux x64 build
- Keyboard shortcuts

## v2+ Considerations (OUT for now)
- Auto-detection of signature on paper (like Preview)
- Vector/SVG signature tracing
- Dark mode
- Trackpad/tablet drawing
- Batch signing multiple PDFs
- macOS/Windows builds
- Cloud sync of signatures
